sentences.text: 04 . This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Though this application has been filed praying therein four weeks' time to pay the deficit court fee, Mr. Behera, learned ASC for the State-Appellant submits, the court fee of Rs.25,634/- has been paid on 14.03.2024.
3. In view of such submission made, the prayer for seeking time to deposit the court fee is allowed by extending the same till the date of deposit of the deficit court fee.
This application has been filed for condonation of delay.

2. The Appeal has been preferred under Section-74 of the Right to Fair Compensation &
Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013, and there is a delay of 162 days beyond the permissible period of 120 days (60 days + 60 days) in presenting the memorandum of appeal, as pointed out by the Office.
